description: This file implements the BidiNetworkManager class and related classes/functions for managing network requests and responses in a browser automation context, including request interception, response handling, and authentication, within the Playwright project.

classes.name: BidiNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network requests, responses, and interception using the BiDi protocol within a browser automation context.

classes.name: BidiRequest
classes.description: Represents a network request, including redirect handling and request details.

classes.name: BidiRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route delegation, allowing request continuation, fulfillment, or abortion.

methods.name: _onBeforeRequestSent
methods.description: Handles the event before a network request is sent, managing request interception and CORS preflight responses.

methods.name: _onResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a response starts, fetching response data and updating response objects.

methods.name: _onResponseCompleted
methods.description: Handles the event when a response completes, finalizing request and response lifecycle.

methods.name: _onFetchError
methods.description: Handles fetch errors, marking requests as failed.

methods.name: _onAuthRequired
methods.description: Handles authentication challenges, providing credentials or canceling as needed.

methods.name: _deleteRequest
methods.description: Removes a request from internal tracking.

methods.name: _updateProtocolRequestInterception
methods.description: Updates network interception settings based on current configuration.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues a intercepted request with optional overrides.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a request with a custom response.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a request with an error code.
